description: This file defines the HttpResponseToJavaSerializer class, which serializes HttpResponse objects into Java code strings, including headers, cookies, body, delay, and connection options.

classes.name: HttpResponseToJavaSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts HttpResponse objects into Java code strings with proper indentation and formatting.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an HttpResponse object into a formatted Java code string with specified indentation.

methods.name: outputCookies
methods.description: Appends cookie list serialization to the output string.

methods.name: outputHeaders
methods.description: Appends header list serialization to the output string.

methods.name: appendObject
methods.description: Serializes a list of objects using a provided serializer and appends to output.

methods.name: appendNewLineAndIndent
methods.description: Appends a newline and indentation spaces to the output buffer.
